meta.derivedFrom: Starfleet v2 (same token names for the core set, so the portfolio can switch theme)
meta.changes: v2: refined, product-grade direction: Inter with optical sizing, larger scale, more air, pill controls, larger radii, soft shadows, frosted nav.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber as a FILL: primary pill button, CTA, skill bars, the status dot. Text on it uses on-accent. Never as text on light grounds: use accent-ink. Spend it rarely: one amber element per screen is the goal.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on accent fills. Lighter, not darker, so on-accent keeps contrast.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as TEXT, icon and focus ring: eyebrows, text links ('See the project ›'), roles, tags.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the Featured pill and amber tags.

tokens.name: accent-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Hover or selected state of accent-tint.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of accent-tinted controls when they need one.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Slate: category fill only (skill-bar groups, a second chart series). Never an action.

tokens.name: secondary-ink
tokens.usage: Slate as text or icon.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Steel: third category fill. As text on light grounds use tertiary-ink.

tokens.name: tertiary-ink
tokens.usage: Steel as text or icon.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Clay red: errors and destructive states only.

tokens.name: highlight-ink
tokens.usage: Clay as text (error messages).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state; the 'available' status dot.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error state.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background: barely warm white in light, deep navy in dark.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: equals background.

tokens.name: ground-mid
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: equals background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, rows. In light, cards float by shadow, not by border.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover state of dark cards; popovers and menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground (cm-section--alt) and inset areas.

tokens.name: card-bg-start
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: flat surface.

tokens.name: card-bg-end
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: flat surface.

tokens.name: panel-start
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: flat surface.

tokens.name: panel-mid
tokens.usage: Kept for Starfleet compatibility: flat surface.

tokens.name: stat-panel
tokens.usage: Stats panel ground; follows the theme.

tokens.name: nav-scrolled
tokens.usage: Frosted nav: always on, with saturate(180%) blur(20px). The low alpha is what makes the content glow through.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body text. Deep navy, never pure black.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Lead, descriptions, metadata.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions and footnotes only, at 12px or larger. Light 4.5:1 on background, 4.7:1 on surface; dark 6.0:1 on background.

tokens.name: meta-ink
tokens.usage: Periods and dates (mono).

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items and the theme toggle.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Active nav item: text-primary at weight 500 (colour and weight, no underline).

tokens.name: stat-label
tokens.usage: Skill names in the stats panel.

tokens.name: stat-track
tokens.usage: Track behind skill bars.

tokens.name: cta-bg
tokens.usage: Contact pill: amber in both themes.

tokens.name: cta-ink
tokens.usage: Text on cta-bg.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary pill button ground and neutral tags; text on it is text-primary.

tokens.name: fill-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on fill-secondary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px edge where an edge is needed: job rows, social tiles, dark cards.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover edge on rows and tiles.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and under the nav.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of controls whose edge alone carries meaning. Meets 3:1.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: Project card edge: almost invisible in light (the shadow defines the card), a real 1px edge in dark.

tokens.name: panel-edge
tokens.usage: Stats panel edge.

tokens.name: job-edge
tokens.usage: Job row edge; border-strong on hover.

tokens.name: job-tag-ink
tokens.usage: Text in neutral tags.

tokens.name: job-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral tag ground.

tokens.name: job-tag-edge
tokens.usage: Neutral tag edge: none in v2 (kept for compatibility).

tokens.name: secondary-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of slate category pills.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, centred. 48px under 734px wide. Inter at optical size 32 for tight, display-cut letterforms.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section headlines. 36px on mobile. A short sentence, often ending with a full stop.

styles.name: display-feature
styles.usage: Title of the wide feature card in the bento grid.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro under hero and section headlines, text-secondary. 19px on mobile.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small sentence-case kicker above a headline, in accent-ink.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Max line length about 64ch.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Pill tags and the Featured pill.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Stars, forks, language in card footers.

styles.name: mono-stat
styles.usage: Skill values and numbers in data (tabular).

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Periods and dates. Mono is now for data only, never for labels or navigation.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap.

tokens.name: space-tight
tokens.usage: Gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between job rows.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between pill buttons; eyebrow to headline.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Bento grid gap; headline to lead.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Feature-card padding; lead to buttons; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of content sections (80px on mobile).

tokens.name: section-y-lg
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the hero and contact (104px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Skill bars and their track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inset elements, focus boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Job rows, social tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project cards and the stats panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature card in the bento grid and the hero portrait frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, tags, the nav toggle, avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest: in light, the soft shadow is what makes the card.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, with scale(1.01).

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Primary pill.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Stats panel.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom hairline of the frosted nav.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Fixed frosted nav.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Pill buttons and nav targets (touch target).

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and contact pills.

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Hero portrait.

tokens.name: social-tile
tokens.usage: Social icon tiles.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Contact section and running text.

tokens.name: container-hero
tokens.usage: Hero headline block.

tokens.name: container-content
tokens.usage: Experience.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Bento grid and stats.
